 Hon'Ble Dr. Justice Sudhir Kumar Jain

The present petition is filed under section 482 Cr. P. C. for quashing of FIR bearing no.
0442/2013 registered under sections 498A/406/34 IPC at P.S. Dwarka South along with consequential proceedings qua the petitioners stated to be pending in the court of Ms. Surbhi, MM,
South-West District, Dwarka Courts, Delhi/Successor Court.
2. Issue notice.

3. Mr. Pradeep Gahalot, Additional Public Prosecutor assisted by the Investigating Officer SI Ritu,
P.S. Dwarka South, accepts notice on behalf of State/respondent no. 1.
The respondent no. 2 is present in person along with the counsel and accepts notice.

sentences.text: The respondent no

. 2 got married with Ratan Thaltoti, who is stated to be the son of petitioner no.1 on 10.05.2006 as per Christian rights and customs and out of their marriage, one male child,
namely, Master Janardhan Thaltoti was born on 12.02.2010, who at present is under the care and custody of the respondent no. 2.

Subsequently, the matrimonial differences stated to have arisen between the respondent no. 2 and Ratan Thaltoti and they started to live separately since April,
2013.

5. The respondent no. 2 filed petition under section 12 of the Protection of Women From Domestic Violence Act, 2005 titled as Sujata V Ratan Kumar Thaltoti & Ors. bearing MC no. 268/2016 stated to be pending before the court of Ms. Surbhi, MM, South-West District, Dwarka Courts, Delhi.

entities.text: Protection of Women From Domestic Violence Act, 2005
entities.label: STATUTE

entities.text: Sujata V Ratan Kumar Thaltoti & Ors.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is stated that this petition has already been withdrawn by the respondent no. 2.

The respondent no. 2 also filed a maintenance petition under section 125 Cr.P.C. titled as Sujata V Ratan Thaltoti bearing MT no. 113/2013, which was disposed of vide order dated 29.09.2015.
6.

The respondent no. 2 due to matrimonial differences, got registered FIR bearing no. 0442/2013 under sections 498A/406/34 IPC at P.S. Dwarka South wherein the petitioners and Aruna Thaltoti,
wife of the petitioner no.1 were implicated.

Aruna Thaltoti is stated to have expired and proceedings have already been abated vide order dated 11.07.2022 passed by the court of Ms. Charu Dhankar,
MM (Mahila Court-02), Dwarka Courts, Delhi.
Ratan Thaltoti has already been declared Proclaimed Offender vide order dated 15.01.2020 passed by the court of Ms. Charu Dhankar, MM (Mahila Court- 02), Dwarka Courts, Delhi.

The charge-sheet has already been filed after completion of investigation and the trial is stated to be pending before the court of Ms. Surbhi, MM, South-West District,
Dwarka Courts,

The petitioners and the respondent no. 2 are identified by the Investigating Officer SI Ritu, P.S. Dwarka South.

7. The petitioners and the respondent no. 2 during the trial arising out of FIR bearing no.
0442/2013 were referred to Delhi Mediation Centre, Dwarka Court whereby they have settled their disputes vide Settlement dated 31.10.2022.

Out of the Settlement, the petitioner has agreed to pay Rs.25,00,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Lacs Only) to the respondent no. 2 towards full and final satisfaction of her claims/legal entitlements (past, present and future) arising out of the marriage b e t w e e n t h e r e s p o n d e n t n o . 2 a n d R a t a n T h a l t o t i i n c l u d i n g p e r m a n e n t alimony/maintenance/istridhan, etc. and miscellaneous legal expenses as per the schedule as mentioned in the settlement.

It is stated that the petitioner has already paid the entire settled amount to the respondent no. 2, which is acknowledged by the respondent no. 2.
8.

The counsel for the petitioners stated that the petitioners and the respondent no. 2 have amicably settled their disputes vide Settlement dated 31.10.2023, the terms and conditions of which have already been executed.

The petitioners have already paid the entire settled amount to the Prem Kumar Thalatoli And Anr vs State Through Sho Ps Dwarka South And Anr on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/151922941/
2

sentences.text: respondent no. 2.
In these circumstances, it is prayed that the present petition be allowed and FIR bearing no. 0442/2013 be quashed along with consequential judicial proceedings.

9. The respondent no. 2 stated that she has settled with the petitioners out of her own will and without any force, fear or coercion as such, she does not have any objection if the present petition is allowed and FIR bearing no. 0442/2013 is quashed along with consequential judicial proceedings.
11. The Additional Public Prosecutor for the State/respondent no. 1 stated This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 22/12/2023 at 23:46:12 that under the given facts and circumstances, he does not have any objection if the present petition is allowed and FIR bearing no. 0442/2013 is quashed along with consequential judicial proceedings but he expressed his concern regarding one minor son, namely, Master Janardhan Thaltoti in view of the judgment titled as Ganesh V Sudhir Kumar Shrivastava and Ors. (2020) 20 SCC 787, and stated that the respondent no. 2 can settle her claims relating to permanent alimony/maintenance/
istridhan, etc. and miscellaneous and legal expenses with the petitioners but she could not give up the rights which vest or shall be vesting in favour of her minor son, namely, Master Janardhan Thaltoti relating to maintenance and other issues 12.

entities.text: Ganesh V Sudhir Kumar Shrivastava and Ors. (2020) 20 SCC 787
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The respondent no. 2 got married with Ratan Thaltoti on 10.05.2006 and due to matrimonial differences, they are living separately since April, 2013.

The petitioners and the respondent no. 2 have already settled their disputes vide Settlement dated 31.10.2023 and out of the said settlement,
the petitioners have already paid the entire settled amount to the respondent no.2.

After considering all facts, the present petition is allowed and FIR bearing no. 0442/2013 registered under sections 498A/406/34 IPC at P.S. Dwarka South is quashed along with consequential proceedings including judicial proceedings stated to be pending before the court of Ms. Surbhi, MM, South-West District,
Dwarka Courts, Delhi/Successor Court qua the petitioners.

However, it is made clear that the Settlement dated 31.10.2023 and the present proceeding pertaining to quashing of FIR bearing no.
0442/2013 shall not affect in any manner the rights which vest or shall be vesting including the maintenance/inheritance and other issues in favour of one minor son, namely, Master Janardhan Thaltoti in terms of the judgment titled as Ganesh V Sudhir Kumar Shrivastava and Ors.
